title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for in

translated_title: 面向统一视觉语言模型的技能解耦在策略专家蒸馏
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）能够激发视觉语言模型（VLM）的专用视觉能力，但联合优化异构目标往往会引入跨能力的梯度冲突。独立训练专家模型可以缓解这种干扰，但直接的奖励优化可能会使专业知识与奖励作弊偏差纠缠在一起。本文提出了技能解耦的在策略专家蒸馏（SCOPED），该方法训练特定能力的专家模型，并通过奖励引导的反思提取显式技能。在在策略蒸馏过程中，这些技能指导专家监督，同时对统一的学生模型保持不可用，从而鼓励其在推理时无需显式技能即可内化程序性知识。在八个多模态基准测试中，SCOPED始终优于骨干模型和混合能力强化学习，证明了技能解耦的在策略专家蒸馏方法的有效性。
tldr: SCOPED通过训练特定能力的专家模型并利用奖励引导反思提取技能，在在策略蒸馏中使统一视觉语言模型无需显式技能即可内化专家的程序性知识，有效解决了跨能力梯度冲突与奖励作弊问题，在八个多模态基准上优于骨干模型和混合能力强化学习。
